capabilities: Resize images to preset percentages or custom pixel widths via context menu
Resize images with Alt/Option plus mousewheel scroll
Copy images or local file paths to the clipboard
Show images in Finder/Explorer or open them in the default app
Rename image files from the context menu
extras: Known conflicts: with the Minimal theme on Windows, image zoom interferes with the context menu unless disabled via the Style Settings plugin; the Image Converter plugin's right-click menu option should be disabled to avoid conflicts. Accepts donations via GitHub Sponsors or Buy Me a Coffee.
problem: Obsidian lacks built-in image context-menu actions, so resizing an image to exact pixels or revealing the file in the system file browser requires manual work.
summary: Image management plugin that adds a right-click context menu for resizing images to exact pixel dimensions and file operations like copy, rename, and reveal.
